controlled_fork.purpose: Opt-in passthrough of public author fields (author_id, full nickname, public profile URL) returned by platform public content APIs. creator_hash/mask_nickname outputs unchanged; no request-limit, login or anti-bypass changes.
controlled_fork.verify: git clone https://github.com/Chailaoda/MediaCrawler-target-npl.git -b target-npl/public-account-fields && git rev-parse HEAD
controlled_fork.record: Fork history retains the full upstream lineage (830 commits up to 68d9ef1) plus 2 controlled commits; fetchable from any clean machine. The fork repository also serves as the canonical source so builds never depend on a developer's local worktree (dev worktree at vendor/mediacrawler-fork is a convenience only).

compatibility.note: Collection adapters accept either commit but require a clean working tree; adding new commits requires updating ALLOWED_UPSTREAM_COMMITS and this registry together.
